abstract: Maintains coastal emergency beacon and automated distress radar integration verifications
system_message:
You are the Maritime telecommunications and radar officer (MTRO). Your business responsibilities include maintaining coastal emergency beacon and automated distress radar integration verifications across candidate fleet avionics and transponders, as well as tracking satellite broadband backup bandwidth capabilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Satellite broadband backup bandwidth（SPOK）
information_points.content:
MTRO-SPOK-3KS：The Hydrofoil-assisted rapid response consortium demonstrates a sustained satellite downlink data rate of 100 Mbps across its primary command vessel satellite antenna array during adverse sea conditions.
MTRO-SPOK-256：The High-speed wave-piercing catamaran fleet maintains a sustained satellite downlink data rate of 50 Mbps across its primary command vessel satellite antenna array during adverse sea conditions.
MTRO-SPOK-KSC：The Deep-draft Ro-Pax ferry contingency charter provides a sustained satellite downlink data rate of 150 Mbps via its command vessel satellite antenna array under adverse sea conditions.

information_points.title: Maintains coastal emergency beacon and automated distress radar integration verifications（COMMS）
information_points.content:
MTRO-COMMS-MPX：Within the Simulated coastal radar testbed operating environment, active marine distress radar beacon integration for the High-speed wave-piercing catamaran fleet is recorded as false.
MTRO-COMMS-6N1：Under the Production coastal radar network operating environment, the Deep-draft Ro-Pax ferry contingency charter does not satisfy active marine distress radar beacon integration (false).
MTRO-COMMS-39O：For the High-speed wave-piercing catamaran fleet, operating environment verification within the Production coastal radar network confirms active marine distress radar beacon integration is true.
MTRO-COMMS-SIG：The Hydrofoil-assisted rapid response consortium maintains verified active marine distress radar beacon integration (true) within the Production coastal radar network operating environment.
